description: NBER business-cycle peak December 2007, trough June 2009.

title: Bear Stearns rescue
description: JPMorgan Chase agreed to acquire Bear Stearns with Federal Reserve support on Mar 16, 2008.

title: Lehman Brothers bankruptcy
description: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy on Sep 15, 2008, the peak of the Global Financial Crisis.

title: Emergency Economic Stabilization Act (TARP) signed
description: TARP enacted Oct 3, 2008 after the House initially rejected the bill on Sep 29, 2008.

timing_note: weekend; first session is next TSP business day
title: Euro-area sovereign debt crisis (first Greek bailout)
description: First Greek financial-assistance package agreed May 2, 2010; acute phase eased after ECB 'whatever it takes' remarks Jul 26, 2012.

title: Flash Crash
description: U.S. equity indexes fell and rebounded within minutes on the afternoon of May 6, 2010.

title: Tohoku earthquake/tsunami and Fukushima nuclear accident
description: Magnitude 9.0 earthquake and tsunami struck Japan on Mar 11, 2011 (relevant to I Fund exposure).

timing_note: after U.S. close Fri
title: S&P downgrades U.S. credit rating to AA+
description: After the 2011 debt-limit standoff, S&P lowered the U.S. long-term rating to AA+ after markets closed Fri Aug 5, 2011; first trading reaction Mon Aug 8, 2011.

title: Taper tantrum
description: Chairman Bernanke's May 22, 2013 testimony raised the prospect of slowing asset purchases; Treasury yields rose sharply over the following months.

title: Russia seizes and annexes Crimea
description: Russian forces seized Crimea beginning late February 2014; annexation declared Mar 18, 2014.

title: Yuan devaluation and Aug 24 global selloff
description: PBOC devalued the yuan on Aug 11, 2015; global equities sold off, with extreme U.S. opening volatility on Aug 24, 2015.

timing_note: Fri evening after U.S. close
title: Paris terrorist attacks
description: Coordinated terrorist attacks in Paris on the evening of Nov 13, 2015 (Friday).

title: First Fed rate increase since 2006
description: FOMC raised the federal funds target range to 0.25-0.50% on Dec 16, 2015.

timing_note: result known overnight
title: UK votes to leave the EU (Brexit referendum)
description: Referendum held Jun 23, 2016; result known overnight, first full market reaction Jun 24, 2016.

title: February 2018 volatility spike
description: VIX more than doubled on Feb 5, 2018 and several short-volatility products collapsed.

title: U.S.-China trade war escalates
description: Section 301 tariff actions against China announced Mar 22, 2018; Phase One deal signed Jan 15, 2020.

title: U.S. strike kills Qasem Soleimani; Iran retaliates
description: U.S. drone strike on Jan 3, 2020; Iranian missile strikes on U.S. bases Jan 8, 2020.

timing_note: weekend; first session is next TSP business day
title: NBER recession (Feb - Apr 2020)
description: NBER business-cycle peak February 2020, trough April 2020.

title: COVID-19 market crash
description: U.S. equities fell sharply from the Feb 19, 2020 peak to the Mar 23, 2020 low; WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on Mar 11, 2020.

timing_note: weekend; first session is next TSP business day
title: Fed cuts rates to zero and restarts QE
description: Emergency FOMC action on Sunday Mar 15, 2020 lowered the target range to 0-0.25%.

title: Fed announces open-ended asset purchases and credit facilities
description: Federal Reserve announced extensive new measures on Mar 23, 2020, the date of the COVID-crash equity low.

title: Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine efficacy announcement
description: Interim Phase 3 results announced Nov 9, 2020 triggered a large rotation into small caps and value stocks.

title: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
description: Russia began a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on Feb 24, 2022, followed by commodity-price spikes and sanctions.

title: Fed begins 2022-23 hiking cycle
description: FOMC raised rates on Mar 16, 2022, the first of eleven increases through Jul 26, 2023; 2022 saw simultaneous stock and bond declines (F Fund drawdown).

title: Fed raises rates 75 bp
description: First 75-basis-point FOMC increase since 1994, Jun 15, 2022, after a hot May CPI report.

title: 2023 debt-limit standoff (G Fund extraordinary measures)
description: Treasury began extraordinary measures (including suspending G Fund investment) on Jan 19, 2023; Fiscal Responsibility Act signed Jun 3, 2023. G Fund investors are made whole by law.

title: Silicon Valley Bank failure and regional bank stress
description: SVB was closed Mar 10, 2023; regulators announced systemic-risk measures Mar 12; First Republic failed May 1, 2023.

title: Fitch downgrades U.S. to AA+
description: Fitch lowered the U.S. long-term rating to AA+ on Aug 1, 2023.

timing_note: weekend; Mon 2023-10-09 (Columbus Day) was not a TSP business day
title: Hamas attack on Israel and Gaza war
description: Hamas-led attack on Israel on Saturday Oct 7, 2023, followed by war in Gaza.

title: Yen carry-trade unwind global selloff
description: Japanese equities fell sharply and VIX spiked intraday on Aug 5, 2024 amid a yen carry-trade unwind.

title: Fed begins easing cycle with 50 bp cut
description: FOMC lowered the target range by 50 bp on Sep 18, 2024.

title: I Fund benchmark change complete
description: I Fund finished transitioning from MSCI EAFE to MSCI ACWI IMI ex USA ex China ex Hong Kong (announced complete Oct 30, 2024).

timing_note: after U.S. close
title: Reciprocal-tariff announcement and selloff
description: Broad 'reciprocal' tariffs announced after the close Apr 2, 2025; steep declines Apr 3-8; 90-day pause announced Apr 9, 2025.

timing_note: after U.S. close Fri
title: Moody's downgrades U.S. to Aa1
description: Moody's lowered the U.S. rating to Aa1 after the close on Fri May 16, 2025, leaving no AAA rating from the three major agencies.

title: Israel-Iran war and U.S. strikes on Iranian nuclear sites
description: Israel struck Iran on Jun 13, 2025; U.S. struck Fordow and other sites Jun 21-22, 2025 (Sat evening ET); ceasefire Jun 24, 2025.

title: Federal government shutdown (BLS data gap)
description: Lapse in appropriations from Oct 1, 2025; October 2025 CPI and unemployment observations were not published (missing in BLS/FRED series).

timing_note: announced late Apr 7 ET / Apr 8 local; first reaction may be 2026-04-08
title: U.S.-Iran two-week ceasefire announced
description: Ceasefire announced Apr 7-8, 2026 (Pakistan-brokered); Strait of Hormuz access remained contested.

title: U.S. declares Iran truce over; renewed strikes
description: After attacks on three commercial ships Jul 6-7, 2026, the U.S. President said the truce was over; renewed exchanges followed for about three weeks.
